qualifications: First-nonzero writer/consumer clocks are descriptive; chain rule permits simultaneous effects and they do not establish staged role birth.
The fixed-C0 blocker replaces the selected writer/page while other captured state remains; it is a partial conditional blocker, not complete band mediation.
Matched-depth updates L22/L19 while all primary endpoint state measurements remain L23/L20 by design.
Mamba x_proj/dt_proj is a shared native writer-clock-selector surface affecting retention and contemporaneous read as well as state formation.
Qwen and Mamba effect magnitudes and state bytes are plotted in separate family panels and are not normalized into a common tensor scale.
Fresh held and Canada/Brazil transfer contexts are absent when interval_limit is set; smoke trends are mechanics/development observations only.

geometry.resident_model_geometry: one full endpoint resident; only selected native parameters require gradients

scheduling_contract.operation_accounting: runtime report records native prefill, suffix-token, direct-full, train-forward, and state-replay counts
